## Where I left off

The SRE take-home exercise for Ethan Moradi was built from scratch, scoped to a 3-hour box with Terraform + docker compose only (no Kubernetes), and moved into its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` via a subtree split so infra history is not exposed. A rubric was added with four areas scored 0–3 by two independent reviewers (Maya and Noa), with no pass threshold — the panel decides. The `hiring/` folder was removed from the `maya/sre-take-home` branch and no PR was opened in infra; the exercise has not been sent to the candidate.

- [done] Scenario: broken alert rule (`http_requests_total` vs `http_server_requests_total`), connection leak in flaky-svc, over-broad `s3:*` IAM policy
- [done] Compose builds flaky-svc from source (multi-stage golang → distroless), so no prebuilt image and works on Apple Silicon
- [done] `RUBRIC.md` with 4 areas, no cut-off, Noa as second reviewer
- [done] Private repo created and subtree pushed (3 commits, exercise paths only)
- [en-cours] Nothing running; the exercise is ready for a collaborator invite
- [next-step] Call with the candidate Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv time, then Maya sends the exercise herself
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch `docker buildx --load` failed (exporter can't load manifest lists); prebuilt amd64 image gave `exec format error` on arm64 — solved by building from source (source: t05)
- [decision] No Kubernetes part, 3 hours max, terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [decision] Compose must build flaky-svc from source, no published image (source: t06)
- [decision] No score threshold; panel decides, Noa is second reviewer (source: t10)
- [decision] Exercise lives in its own private repo, deleted from infra branch, no infra PR (source: t12, t14)
- [decision] Maya sends the exercise herself after the call; the agent must not email anyone (source: t16)
